question: The Village Press avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
The Village Press
is an independent New Zealand company based in Hawke's Bay. It was founded and is owned by Wayne and Maureen Startup, with former NZX boss Mark Weldon also holding a stake and serving as chairman. They produce extra virgin olive oils and cold-pressed avocado oils.
Scoop - New Zealand News
